title: Past Unreal Conditionals
description: Conditionals about past that didn't happen
intro: Past unreal conditionals express what WOULD HAVE happened IF something else had happened (but it didn't). Structure: ЕСЛИ БЫ + past tense, [то] + past tense + БЫ. Если бы я знал, я бы помог. (If I had known, I would have helped.) Note: Russian doesn't distinguish 'would' from 'would have' - both use бы + past. Context and time markers clarify. The particle бы can appear in EITHER or BOTH clauses. Common with regrets: Жаль, что... Если бы только...
rules: Structure: Если бы + past, [то] ... бы + past
Same form for present and past unreal - context determines time
Бы can appear in both clauses: Если бы знал, то сказал бы
Regrets: Жаль, что не... / Если бы только... (If only...)
examples: Если бы я знал вчера, я бы тебе сказал. (If I had known yesterday, I would have told you.)
Если бы он пришёл, мы бы всё обсудили. (If he had come, we would have discussed everything.)
Жаль, что ты не был там. Было бы интереснее. (Too bad you weren't there. It would have been more interesting.)
Если бы только я послушал! (If only I had listened!)

items.prompt: Если бы я _____, я бы тебе помог. (had known)
items.promptEnglish: If I had known, I would have helped you.

items.prompt: Если бы он позвонил, мы бы _____. (would have met)
items.promptEnglish: If he had called, we would have met.

items.prompt: _____, что ты не пришёл. (It's a pity)
items.promptEnglish: It's a pity that you didn't come.

items.prompt: Если бы ты _____ раньше, ты бы успел. (had left)
items.promptEnglish: If you had left earlier, you would have made it.

items.prompt: Было бы лучше, если бы он _____. (had stayed)
items.promptEnglish: It would have been better if he had stayed.

items.prompt: Если бы только я _____ тогда! (had listened)
items.promptEnglish: If only I had listened then!
items.hint: If only = Если бы только + past

items.prompt: Мы бы _____, если бы погода была хорошая. (would have gone)
items.promptEnglish: We would have gone if the weather had been good.

items.prompt: Если бы я _____ деньги, я бы купил машину. (had had)
items.promptEnglish: If I had had money, I would have bought a car.

items.prompt: Он бы _____, если бы мог. (would have helped)
items.promptEnglish: He would have helped if he could have.

items.prompt: Если бы она _____ раньше, она бы не опоздала. (had woken up)
items.promptEnglish: If she had woken up earlier, she wouldn't have been late.
items.hint: Если бы + past tense for unreal condition
items.explanation: Unreal past: если бы проснулась (past tense after если бы).

items.prompt: Мы бы всё _____, если бы ты нам рассказал. (would have understood)
items.promptEnglish: We would have understood everything if you had told us.
items.explanation: Would have: бы поняли (past perfective for result).

blanks: Если бы я _____ об этом, я бы сказал. (had known)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Unreal past: если бы + past tense
hints: In unreal past conditionals with если бы, what tense follows in the subordinate clause?
explanations: Unreal past conditionals use если бы + past tense: 'Если бы я знал' (If I had known). The past tense after бы expresses a hypothetical situation that didn't actually occur.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: If he comes, I'll tell him.
minimalPairs.explanation: No бы: this is a real, possible future condition. Both verbs are perfective future (придёт, скажу), expressing what WILL happen IF the condition is met.

minimalPairs.context: Если бы он пришёл, я бы сказал.
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: If he had come, I would have told him.
minimalPairs.explanation: Бы + past tense in both clauses marks this as unreal/hypothetical. Both пришёл and сказал are perfective past forms used with бы to express something that didn't actually happen.

items.word: Если бы он позвонил, я бы ответил.
Если бы было время, пришёл бы.
